title: Case 037: Shower Repair Request
initial_request:
Shower cable leading to the shower handle is damaged and leaking. 
Please replace
overview: The tenant reported a leaking, damaged shower cable and asked for it to be replaced. The landlord approved replacement of the shower hose. Northbridge Lettings assigned Beacon Utilities, and a repair visit was arranged for Thursday, 4 April 2024, between 12 and 4. The provider reported that it replaced the snapped shower hose and sent an attachment-91-document; the landlord was informed and the request was marked complete.
outcome: The contractor replaced the snapped shower hose and sent an attachment-91-document.
